page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with line numbers (10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35) in the right margin. Below the text, one indented gloss line, "Intellige hic Kikar ponderale, non nummarium." Catchword "COS-" at the lower right. Running head and page number at the top.

main_text.p: Iudic. 6.v. 19. Ruth. 2.17. Hæc fuit communissima & notissima Hebræorum mensura, & quasi reliquarum mensurarum mensura, quæ tantum capiebat in aridis, quantum in liquidis bathus. 5. Letech, siue Semicorus, 5.epharum. Hos.3.v.2. 6. Corus, siue Chomer, amplissima aridorum mensura, 10.epharum. 1.Reg. 4.verf. 22.cap. 5.ver. 11. 2.Chron. 27.v.5.Luc. 16.v.7. Sequuntur mensura liquidorum in sacris, hoc ordine. 1.Logus, mensura minima, erat vigesima quarta pars sati, seu duodecima hinis. Leuit.14. 2. Hin, sexta pars bathi, capiens 12.logos. Exod.29. 10 v. 40.c. 30.v. 24.Leuit. 19.v.36. 3. Bathus, mensura amplissima, eiusdem capacitatis in liquidis, cuius erat epha in aridis. Fuit 72.logorum, (u limidiæ[?] ohmæ nostratis. 1.Reg. 7.v.26. 2.Paral. 4.v.5. Bathus præcisè capiebat amphoram, siue metretam, seu cadum. Hinc colligere est, quantum ceperint (ex hydriæ seu aquales Iohan.2.v.6. nimirum singulæ binas aut ternas amphoras id est bathos totidem, qui efficiunt ohmas nostrates sex. Cæterum pondera etiam seruiunt explorandæ magnitudini corporum siue solidorum. In sacris celebrantur ista. 1. Siclus; qui 20 erat sacer, regius & communis. Sacer in auro ponderabat aureos Vngaricos quatuor. Num. 7.v.50. communis, duos Gen.24.v.22. sacer in argento ponderabat dimidium Imperialem thalerum, Num. 7.v.13. communis quadrantem. 2.Sam.14.verf. 27. sacer in ære & ferro semunciam, communis didrachmum. 1.Sam. 17.v.57. 2.Sam. 21.v.16. Ad siclum regium quod attinet, ille ponderabat tres drachmas, drei Quintlein[?]. 2.Maneh vulgaris, ponderabat 15. thaleros imperiales; regia totidem; sanctuarij, 30. imperiales. 1.Reg. 10.v.17. 2.Paral. 9.v.16. Neh. 7.v.71. 72. 25 Ezech. 45.v.12. 3. Kikar vulgare minus, ponderabat 750. Imperiales: maius, 1250. regium, 1125. sanctuarij, 1500. Imperiales. 1.Reg. 16.verf. 26. Exod. 38.v.25. 1.Reg. 9.v.14. Exod. 39.verf. 24. Intellige hic Kikar ponde- 30 rale, non numma- 35 rium.
Intellige hic Kikar ponderale, non nummarium.

page.notes: Right margin numbers 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are line numbers, placed at their lines. "Hos." is printed "Hof." (long s). The word after "(u" is unclear. "drei Quintlein" is black letter and partly unclear. "Quintlein" is uncertain. The position of "Logus" and "Hin" as italic is approximate. The gloss at the foot is indented and in the same type size as the text; it is kept as a foot paragraph. The "15" line-number is marked in the text as "thaleros".
